hints.title: A range of balances
hints.body: A joker means there is not just one possible balance; track the smallest and largest possible balances.

hints.title: Joker effects
hints.body: A joker can decrease the balance by one, leave it unchanged, or increase it by one.

hints.title: Keep the range alive
hints.body: If the maximum possible balance becomes negative, the prefix has too many closes. At the end, zero must be inside the range.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
low = 0
high = 0
for ch in text:
    if ch == '(':
        low += 1
        high += 1
    else if ch == ')':
        low = max(0, low - 1)
        high -= 1
        if high < 0: return false
    else:
        low = max(0, low - 1)
        high += 1
return low == 0
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
